View transitions have been implemented across 7 files. Here's a summary of what was added:

**Shared element morph** — Product images use matching `view-transition-name: product-{slug}` on both the grid thumbnail and detail hero, so the browser automatically morphs between them during navigation.

**Directional page slides** — `TransitionLink` sets `data-direction` on `<html>` before navigation, and `NavigationObserver` detects `popstate` events for back-button presses. CSS uses `html[data-direction]` selectors to apply slide-to-left/slide-from-right (forward) or slide-to-right/slide-from-left (backward) animations on `::view-transition-old(root)` and `::view-transition-new(root)`.

**Suspense skeleton → content** — The actual content areas (`.product-grid-content`, `.product-info-content`) use a CSS `content-appear` animation that smoothly fades in and translates up from the skeleton state.

**prefers-reduced-motion** — A `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)` block sets all view transition animation durations to `0.01ms`, disables the content-appear and skeleton pulse animations, and removes hover transitions.
